name: Feature-Aware Trivariate Spline Reconstruction
definition: A method to transform discrete volumetric data into continuous spline representation with tensor-product regular structure, solving storage/rendering costs and enabling physical analysis by preserving density, feature alignment, compactness, structured regularity, homogeneity, and continuity.
summary: Feature-Aware Trivariate Spline Reconstruction converts discrete volumetric data into a continuous, regular spline representation by explicitly constructing feature-aligned frame fields and smooth parameterizations to remesh data into regular patches.
